recommendations.title: How the Claude Code team thinks about verification
recommendations.verdict: 把「验证层」当成一套独立系统来建，是从同时跑一两个 agent 走到跑上百个的唯一分水岭。
recommendations.reason: 文章不只讲该写哪几种测试，而是给出 Anthropic 内部的完整机制：E2E/property/differential 的分工、39 项可靠性清单、提交门禁的三档模式，以及怎么评估评审器本身。
key_points: Anthropic 约 90% 的代码由 Claude 写并评审；给 agent 配独立的 grader 按评分表复核，结构化文件生成任务的通过率最多提高 10 个点，越难的任务收益越大。
只押注三类测试：E2E（难以作假、能指出坏在哪）、property（用 fast-check / Hypothesis / proptest 生成上千输入打边界）、differential（新旧系统同输入跑对比，适合大规模迁移）。
把验证写进仓库：.claude/skills 下的 verify skill，提交前必跑；检查连续三轮不过就交给人。测试 flaky 时不许 skip、sleep 或重试到过。
制度比技巧更关键：39 项可靠性清单每项带一个能从 diff 读出的触发条件；REVIEW.md 只从 base 分支读，使判据不被变更改动；commit 盖验证标记并配 off/observe/enforce 三档门禁；定期用回滚率与三段召回率复核评审器。

一句话判断：这篇文章的价值不在「要多写测试」这种常识，而在于它把 agent 的验证能力当成一套需要设计、需要被审计的系统，并且给出了 Anthropic 自己在 90% 代码由模型产出的规模下跑通的机制。

1. 为什么验证决定了并行度。没有验证回路，你只能同时跑一两个 Claude，因为每个改动都得自己看。有了它，几十上百个并行才有意义。作者引用内部实验：给 agent 配一个独立的 grader 按 rubric 打分，任务成功率最多提升 10 个点，且难题上收益最大。这个数字比任何「agent 很强」的宣传都更有说服力——提升来自反馈，而不是模型本身。

2. 三类测试的分工。E2E 是唯一「难以被糊弄」的层次：功能要么通了要么没通，而且能具体说出坏在哪；单测更快更稳，却可能全绿而功能已坏，因为 agent 和测试都没理解完整任务。property test 补的是「人没想到的边界」——先写一句你认为不可能失败的性质，再用库生成上千输入去证伪，这类输入不带写代码那个 agent 的偏见，重写场景尤其有用。differential test 针对大规模迁移：新旧系统同输入对比，差异就是 bug 或破坏性变更，关键是输入要随机化或用生产流量抽样，并对空白这类无关差异做归一化。

3. 落地方式。真正跑起来的一步是 verify skill：放在仓库里、离相关代码尽量近，让 agent 知道提交前要跑它，然后反复让 Claude 自己迭代、压测这个 skill，把它当冒烟测试底座。文章反复强调「跑起来比测试更重要」——web 用 Chrome 扩展，移动端用 iOS/Android MCP，桌面用 computer use，后端就在本地起服务。

4. 制度比技巧更关键。39 项可靠性清单，每项带一个能从 diff 读出的触发条件、一条检查、以及它背后的线上事故；Claude 只读触发命中的 3 到 10 项，没人需要背事故史。评审不靠叠加更多 reviewer，而是维护 REVIEW.md 告诉评审者该看什么，并让每一轮评审接上前几轮的上下文，而不是每轮从零重查。最锋利的一条：如果一个变更能改动评判它的检查，这个检查就是坏的——所以 Code Review 只从 base 分支读规则。加上三道门：便宜检查先跑，commit 盖验证标记，commit gate 分 off / observe / enforce 三档渐进启用，被拦两次后放行一次以免 agent 卡死。

5. 谁来评审评审者。团队跟踪合并后被回滚的比例、维护者在合并前拒掉的比例，以及规模匹配、至今干净的样本。做正式评估时，把仓库恢复到当时状态、每题给一句话答案，只有准确描述该 bug 的发现才得分，并用已合并且稳定的改动做对照来抑制过度报警。召回率分三段独立统计，这样才看得出系统有没有丢掉自己已经找到的 bug。规则也不是越堆越好：测试、验证步骤和 md 文件只会膨胀，要定期清理。

recommendations.title: Inference engineering for software engineers
recommendations.verdict: 从 frontier API 换到开源模型是一条分两阶段的工程路径，难点不在换 base URL，而在延迟长尾、缓存命中和容量采购。
recommendations.reason: 把「什么时候该离开 frontier API、怎么选模型和供应商、多租户与专用 GPU 怎么取舍」讲成了一条可执行的路线，并给出 Uber 每 token 成本降 50%、Pinterest 90%、AT&T 56% 这类真实参照。
key_points: 典型路径是三步：先用 frontier API，再换推理服务商的多租户 API（改 base URL 即可），最后租专用 GPU。前两步通常和产品找到 PMF 同步发生。
选模型靠私有 eval 而不是公开榜单。Artificial Analysis 的对照里，Sonnet 5.5 每任务平均 $5.46，Kimi K3 约 $2.00（便宜约 60%）；注意这是每任务成本而非每 token，因为不同模型完成任务消耗的 token 数不一样。
多租户下 TTFT 的长尾来自三处：噪声邻居（被批到更贵的请求上）、冷启动（扩容新副本要等）、冷缓存（落到没有对应 KV cache 的副本）。p95/p99 和 p50 一样重要，服务端推理时间与用户实感延迟要分开测。
无状态 API 被 Fireworks CTO 称作「原罪」：客户端像在调无状态接口，缓存责任全落在服务商。prompt cache 命中率可从响应 usage 读出，是可观测也能优化的抓手；撞限流、性能不一致、超付三条信号出现时才该上专用 GPU，且要长期预算承诺。
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这是一篇少见的、把 LLM 推理当成运维问题而不是模型问题来写的文章，适合任何要为自己的产品定 AI 成本结构的人。

1. 推理服务商是什么。它们不预训练基础模型——一次 frontier 级预训练要花数百万美元，只有超大厂和 frontier 实验室付得起——而是托管开源权重模型，靠后训练、效率优化和专用硬件竞争。Modal 强调可编程与代码可见，Fireworks 主打专用部署加微调与延迟保证，Baseten 往上叠沙箱、治理和 agent 构建层。一个细节值得记住：Fireworks 的 Ember-1 在 Kimi K3 基础上后训练，质量接近但推理 token 少 40%——同样的答案用更少的 token，成本优势比单价比价更真实。

2. 另一个被低估的动机是可用性。文章引用各家状态页：Anthropic 自报 99.5%，OpenAI API 99.97%、ChatGPT 99.2%，都低于云厂商常见的四个九。更要命的是「性能退化时段不算宕机」，而多租户意味着退化会随机落到某些租户头上，你既看不见也做不了什么。所以只要关键路径要承诺 99.99%，就不能只挂一家 frontier API，LLM gateway 加 fallback 是必然产物。

3. 迁移的三个理由：成本、延迟可控、可定制。成本这条最普遍——很多请求根本不需要 frontier 模型的能力，路由到便宜模型没人会察觉；Uber 的每 token 成本降一半主要靠 prompt 感知的 smart router。选模型的正道是私有 eval：Satya Nadella 在播客里说私有 eval 会成为公司 IP 的一部分，先拿 trace 找确定性工作流，再换模型、用 trace 微调。只有公开榜单时，退一步做 A/B，让一部分工程师先用新模型并反馈。

4. 多租户阶段的三个坑。TTFT 的分布有长右尾，p95/p99 才是用户抱怨的来源；服务端 instrumented 的推理时间和 client 端看到的实感延迟要分开量，后者还包含网络和 TLS 握手，连接池这类常规优化仍然有效。缓存这条最容易被忽略：无状态 REST 接口让应用层看起来很干净，代价是服务商要在分布式环境里保证 prefix/KV cache 命中，命中率直接决定成本和首字延迟，而且它从 API 响应的 usage 字段就能读出来。

5. 什么时候该上专用 GPU。信号是三条：频繁撞限流、性能一致性无法接受、为实际用量付了过多钱。上了专用节点，工程细节才真正开始——模型大小、交互还是吞吐优先、KV cache 留多少、故障怎么切——文章在这一段进入订阅区，只留了标题结构：专用 GPU 配置与 speculative decoding（用闲置算力加一个 draft 模型加速解码）。所以这篇免费部分覆盖了决策与多租户阶段，落地的参数细节要看全文。

我的推荐：先做两件不需要采购的事——把各模型的每任务成本用自己的 eval 集量一遍，再把 prompt cache 命中率接进监控。等这两条给出数字，要不要谈专用 GPU 自然有答案。

recommendations.title: Unlocking Stable On-Policy RL on TPU with Bitwise-Zero Train–Inference Mismatch
recommendations.verdict: 把「on-policy」从调度层承诺变成数值层事实：采样器和训练器对同一个 token 必须给出逐位相同的 logprob。
recommendations.reason: 根因分析干净——浮点加法不满足结合律，不同的规约顺序就会产生不同的 logprob——并给出四条可复用的实现规则和三路对账方法，不是只报一个结果。
key_points: 采样器逐 token 解码、训练器整批前后向，两条路径的 token 形状与算子不同；JAX 按输入形状特化计算，规约顺序与中间精度随之不同，同一权重下 logprob 的比特也就不一样。
这个差距是隐蔽的 off-policy：训练计划是 on-policy 的，数值执行却在多轮轨迹上不断累积偏差；判别标准是原始浮点字节逐位相等，零容差。
用 decode / prefill / trainer 三路而非两路对账，能把误差定位到具体环节；四条实现规则是固定分片内累加顺序（Pallas + float32 累加）、跨分片按源 rank 顺序相加、统一 log-softmax 打分尾部、用 custom_vjp 让训练前向复用服务端 kernel。
在 64 颗 TPU v5p（DP8×TP8）上验证；200 步 FrozenLake + Qwen3-8B 的对照中，Zero-TIM 每步 logprob 平均绝对差为 0 且 solve rate 上升，而 TIS 只调整更新权重、消不掉底层不匹配。
recommendations.full_analysis:
一句话判断：这是把「数值一致性」从工程迷信变成可验证合同的一篇短文，凡是自己跑 RL 或要复现别人 RL 结果的人都该读。

1. 问题是什么。LLM 的 RL 里模型就是策略，真正的 on-policy 要求每个动作都由同一份策略生成并评估。同步循环保证了「同一批权重」，但没保证「同一套算术」。生产环境里采样和训练走两条专门化的执行路径：采样器在增量解码时记录行为 logprob，训练器在整批前向反向里重新算同一个 token 的 logprob。权重相同，两个实现仍可能给出不同的数值。

2. 根因很朴素：矩阵乘要累加部分和，归一化要统计量，张量并行要把分片结果合起来，而浮点加法不满足结合律。改变相加的树，就改变了舍入发生的位置，bfloat16 下尤其明显。JAX 又会按输入形状特化计算，训练前向还跑在带自动微分的程序里——这两条路径的规约顺序和中间精度从来没对齐过。所以模型方程没变，算术变了。

3. 合同怎么定。对每个被采样的动作，在相同 rollout 权重、相同 token 历史、相同采样设置下，解码、服务端 prefill、训练器前向三条路径必须给出逐位相同的 logprob，比较的是原始浮点字节，没有容差。三路而非两路是设计上的巧思：直接比采样器和训练器只能说明「有差距」，加了 prefill 这个中间检查点，就能区分是服务引擎自身不自洽，还是跨编译/微分边界出的问题。这对任何 RL 栈都可照搬。

4. 四条实现规则。其一，分片内用 batch-invariant 的 Pallas kernel 控制累加顺序与中间精度：按固定分块顺序遍历、以 float32 累加、显式转回输出类型，累加器跨 tile 延续而不是从转换后的输出续算，覆盖注意力和 MLP 投影以及 LM 头。其二，行并行投影的跨分片合并要把通信和相加分开，用 ppermute 搬运部分和，再由每个 rank 按源 rank 顺序相加，让规约顺序写在程序里而不是交给集合通信实现去选。其三，对齐必须延伸到最后那个被采样动作的概率：三条路径用同一套采样变换和同一份 Pallas log-softmax，且沿用 rollout 时产生的 token id，不重新选动作。其四，训练侧用 custom_vjp 包住服务端 kernel，前向值来自服务 kernel，反向由一份镜像其累加与类型转换的可微副本提供，另外用 xla_allow_excess_precision=false 压住 kernel 周围的额外精度。

5. 结果与位置。64 颗 TPU v5p（DP8×TP8）多机验证，200 步 FrozenLake 用公开的 Qwen3-8B，GSPO-token loss 配 leave-one-out 优势。Zero-TIM 在每个记录步上采样器与训练器的 logprob 平均绝对差都是 0，solve rate 同步上升；标准配置与 token 级截断重要性采样（TIS）都仍有非零差——TIS 只是调整更新权重，没有消掉底层不匹配。同期 vLLM+TorchTitan、LMSys Miles 也在做 batch-invariant kernel 这条路，可见这已经是稳定大规模 RL 收敛的事实标准。对自建 RL 的团队来说，三路对账合同比任何单个 kernel 优化都更值得先落地。

我的推荐：不必上 TPU 也能借鉴——先在自己的训练/推理栈上加一条「同权重下 logprob 逐位相等」的断言，你会发现误差来源比你预想的多。

items.title: Claude was trained on protein sequences at scale (26 minute read)
items.summary: Tests show that the latest Claude models were trained on protein sequences at scale. The models can predict the next amino acid if given the start of little-studied bacterial proteins. No other model tested can do this, and the models fail to predict the sequence if the protein is shuffled. Fable 5.2 beats every open protein language model tested.
items.score_reason: 实测 Claude 在大规模蛋白序列上训练过，可预测未知菌蛋白下一个氨基酸
items.highlight: 作者取668个几乎无人研究的细菌与古菌蛋白做下一个氨基酸预测，并用打乱顺序的同序列作对照。Fable 5.2真序列准确率54%、打乱后仅9%，且随家族序列数增长，GPT与Gemini接近零，说明这是序列级知识而非背诵论文。
items.excerpt: A next-amino-acid test on little-studied proteins finds that the latest Claude models were trained on protein sequences at scale. Other frontier models show no sign of it. Give Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Opus 5.5 the start of a little-studied bacterial protein and they predict the next amino acid.

items.title: Measuring alignment eval tells (16 minute read)
items.summary: Investigator agents can increasingly distinguish alignment evals from capabilities evals, identifying them as artificial or "honeypot" environments designed to test bad behavior. Opus 5.5 and Astra agents differentiate these by noticing unrealistic scenarios and specific task-level cues. The study's findings suggest that while current models can identify common alignment evaluations, making them less detectable can refine their efficacy.
items.score_reason: 调查型 agent 能识别对齐评测的「蜜罐」特征，含 Opus 5.5 与 Astra 对比
items.highlight: METR把调查代理放进19个对齐评估和36个能力评估环境，让其判断任务目的。随着模型变强，判别力上升，Opus 5.5已能把每个对齐评估排在所有能力评估之上，主要线索是环境看起来是伪造的，以及任务是引诱作恶的蜜罐。
items.excerpt: Models sometimes can tell that an eval is an alignment eval, not a capabilities eval. To figure out what features of an eval tell a model what kind of eval it's in, we run investigator agents on a set of evals for both capabilities and alignment.

items.title: From Skiplists to B+ Trees: Making Valkey Sorted Sets More Memory Efficient (7 minute read)
items.summary: Valkey 9.2 replaces large sorted sets' skiplist index with a B+ tree that packs entries together and uses SIMD-assisted searches. In a five-million-member test, per-member index overhead fell by 36% to 43%, while command behavior stayed the same. The release is still in candidate testing.
items.score_reason: Valkey 9.2 用 B+ 树替换 skiplist，五百万成员测试索引开销降 36–43%
items.highlight: 有序集合超过listpack阈值后原本用跳表，每节点约37字节指针开销且缓存不友好。Valkey 9.2改用61叉fbtree，分数与成员打包存放，五百万成员下每成员开销从50.3字节降到28.5或32字节，ZADD吞吐+105%。
items.excerpt: A sorted set can spend more memory describing how its elements are ordered than storing the elements themselves. In Valkey 9.2 that changes: the skiplist is replaced by a high-fanout B+ tree variant called fbtree.

items.title: BenchProofer: Formally Verified Coding Benchmarks, on Demand (11 minute read)
items.summary: BenchProofer adds formal specifications, verified reference implementations, and audits to coding benchmarks, with SWE-Proof covering all 500 SWE-Bench Verified tasks. Its audit flagged behavioral differences in 134 test-passing Opus 4.8 patches, but human review found actual bugs in only 21 of 41 sampled flags. The distinction matters because a different implementation can still be a valid fix.
items.score_reason: BenchProofer 给编码基准加形式化规格，审计 500 个 SWE-Bench 任务
items.highlight: BenchProofer 从参考修复自动生成形式化规格、可验证实现与证明，用契约加模糊测试为库函数划界。SWE-Bench Verified 的 500 题全做成 SWE-Proof，Opus 4.8 有 134 个通过补丁被标出。
items.excerpt: Today we measure coding agents by counting how many benchmark tasks they resolve, and we decide whether a task is resolved by running a suite of tests. But an agent can pass every test and still be wrong on inputs no test happens to check.

items.title: Secure Exclaves and Ambient Sensing (14 minute read)
items.summary: Apple introduced Secure Exclaves: isolated runtimes on Apple silicon that process microphone and camera data separately from the main operating system. Ambient sensing produces only limited metadata, such as a recognized person or wake-word detection. Raw audio and video stay inside the exclave and are discarded after processing. The design uses a capability-based L4-derived microkernel, the Secure Page Table Monitor for memory isolation, isolated Neural Engine queues, and tightly defined Secure IPC interfaces. An Exclave Indicator Controller verifies that camera or microphone indicators are visible before active sensor data leaves the boundary. HomeView person recognition and “Hey Siri” on iPhone 18 Pro use this flow.
items.score_reason: Apple Secure Exclaves 把麦克风摄像头数据隔离在主系统之外
items.highlight: Secure Exclaves 是基于自研 L4 能力微内核的隔离运行时，用 SPTM 页表监控、内存过滤器与 ANE 独占队列，把摄像头和麦克风原始数据锁在分隔区，只向主系统放行最小元数据。指示灯由独立控制器校验屏幕像素后才放行音频。
items.excerpt: We recently introduced HomeView, which can recognize up to six people to deliver a rich and personalized experience. This capability relies on ambient sensing: using the microphone and camera to understand the surrounding environment and recognize an enrolled user's voice and face.

items.title: Race Against the (Mac)hine: Local Privilege Escalation in Microsoft Defender for macOS (15 minute read)
items.summary: Microsoft Defender for macOS checked IPC clients by looking up a connecting process's PID and then its current executable path, so an unprivileged process could connect and then re-exec into a Microsoft-signed binary to pass the check and send arbitrary commands to the root daemon. A diagnostics command with no authorization check followed hardlinks to read any file as root (CVE-2026-50657), and a quarantine restore request that left out its authorization blob skipped authorization entirely, which let an attacker write a cron entry to /etc/crontab and get a root shell (CVE-2026-50658). Microsoft fixed both in July 2026 Patch Tuesday. The research shows that bugs patched in Defender for Windows reappeared on macOS because peer checks should use audit tokens or XPC code-signing requirements and should block hardlinks, not just symlinks.
items.score_reason: Defender for macOS 本地提权：PID 到路径的 TOCTOU 绕过
items.highlight: macOS 版 Defender 用 connect 时冻结的 pid 配实时路径校验，子进程在窗口内 execve 成白名单签名二进制即绕过；再借硬链接读 root 文件、restore 缺省授权字段写 /etc/crontab 提权。
items.excerpt: Microsoft Defender, like many other EDRs and AVs, is an attractive target for vulnerability research because it runs with the highest privileges and includes many kernel-level components.

items.title: Are unit tests still important when AI agents write the code? (7 minute read)
items.summary: As AI agents increasingly write application code, some developers are experimenting with removing unit tests or entire test suites from continuous integration to save time and token usage. While redundant snapshot tests often provide no value, test suites that enforce explicit rules and run real engines successfully catch critical bugs introduced by agents.
items.score_reason: agent 写代码后单测是否仍必要：删冗余快照测试 vs 保留规则型测试
items.highlight: 作者回溯一个月CI记录与Agent对话：一个快照文件被改24次却从未抓到缺陷，而两条写着业务规则的测试确实让Agent修好了真实bug，判据是预期值来自规则还是代码自身。
items.excerpt: Some developers are taking unit tests out of CI now that agents write their code, and a few are deleting their test suites. Their argument is that agents spend time and tokens writing and repairing tests that mostly repeat the implementation, and the software ends up no better.

items.title: My voice harness is my new operating system (15 minute read)
items.summary: This post discusses a web runtime that allows developers to use voice to control their machines using a new operating layer in the browser through mini-apps.
items.score_reason: 浏览器内语音操作层与 mini-app 的个人实践
items.highlight: Kinlan 用网页、本地 node 守护进程与 Gemini Live 搭成语音 harness：采音经 AudioWorklet 送入守护进程，工具按 OPFS 或磁盘路径路由，模型写的 mini-app 跑在双层沙箱。
items.excerpt: Earlier this year I built an Esper Machine that I was planning to integrate into my IO talk to showcase something cool that we can do on the web. It got me thinking about how we might use voice to do more with my computer, so I built a voice harness.

items.title: Golden Board: Teaching Chess Without a Shared Language (25 minute read)
items.summary: Golden Board packs a visual introduction to chess into a 512 KiB binary message, starting with a bootstrap that teaches the recipient how to decode it. The message includes lessons, exercises, and complete games, while its LLM trials explore ambiguities rather than proving an unknown intelligence would understand it.
items.score_reason: 把国际象棋教学压进 512 KiB 自解压消息，含 LLM 试验
items.highlight: 512 KiB 比特排成 2048×2048 方阵：顶部 32 帧引导层用纯图示教会计数、字节序、CRC-32C 与记录格式，其下分段装入 64 局棋谱（6,890 个半回合）、规则课与带反馈练习；每段带校验和，可自写解码器复现画面。
items.excerpt: Golden Board is a binary message designed to teach chess to an unknown recipient without a shared language, culture, or prior knowledge of the game. It begins by teaching the format needed to read its own contents: 4,194,304 bits, or 512 KiB, arranged into a 2,048 × 2,048 square.

items.title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin? (4 minute read)
items.summary: Qilin is an active Ransomware-as-a-Service operation, claiming 365 victim organizations in three months. Its affiliates receive at least 80% of extortion payments and use double extortion: data theft plus encryption. Reporting links the administrator “Haise” to older identities “Rjun” and “Alexbigboss44,” then to Aleksey Mikhailovich Yakovtsev of St. Petersburg. The attribution relies on forum records, breached Gosuslugi data, Telegram identifiers, email links, and flight records.
items.score_reason: Qilin 勒索团伙管理者身份溯源，含分成与双重勒索
items.highlight: KrebsOnSecurity串起被查封论坛的私信、旧用户名、邮箱与失窃的政务数据库记录，把最活跃勒索团伙Qilin的管理员Haise追溯到圣彼得堡36岁的Aleksey Yakovtsev，其从信用卡套利者逐步转向勒索运营。
items.excerpt: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. Even top Russian hackers make opsec mistakes, and Qilin's admin made missteps pointing to a 36-year-old man in St. Petersburg.

items.title: Why Thinking More Can Make an LLM Dumb
items.summary: In this article, we’ll try to understand why thinking longer can make an LLM dumber.
items.score_reason: ByteByteGo 解释长链思考为何反而降低模型表现，属概念梳理
items.highlight: 模型把中间结论写进上下文后会不断自我强化，题目简单时多余的检查会重复同一结论，甚至引入题外假设把原本正确的答案改错；而仅以正确性打分的奖励机制无法惩罚冗余推理。
items.excerpt: When you ask someone to double-check an answer, you usually expect a better answer. But the opposite is also common: you might revisit a straightforward exam question and convince yourself there's a catch, changing an answer that was correct the first time. A reasoning LLM can do both.

items.title: Formal Verification is Not Verifiable (8 minute read)
items.summary: AI has made formal verification go mainstream. People mean lots of different things when they say something is 'formally verified'. This post attempts to break these down. Formally verified systems can still have bugs, so not all formal verification systems are correct. However, formal verification produces well-defined, reviewable, understandable objects, so it is fairly reliable at finding bugs.
items.score_reason: 拆解「形式化验证」一词的多重含义，指出验证系统仍会有 bug
items.highlight: 作者认为证明本身可免审，但定义、语义模型与证明器仍需人工信任，因此“已形式化验证”必须附带限定；他看好二进制验证与属性测试，悲观于无边界正确性宣称，尤其是多线程与分布式系统。
items.excerpt: AI is making formal verification go mainstream... I wrote in December 2025; after the last 12 months I believe it is hard to argue otherwise. Not only did the number of formal verification startups skyrocket, Claude also wrote a billion lines of Rocq for a single verification project.

items.title: httpx is Vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via Oj Object-Mode JSON Deserialization (2 minute read)
items.summary: Version 1.9.0 of the Ruby httpx gem (CVE-2026-129784, CVSS 8.5) parsed JSON response bodies with Oj in its default object mode when multi_json was missing, which let a malicious server turn its response into arbitrary Ruby objects. JFrog showed an attacker could chain ActiveSupport classes in any Rails app to call Kernel.load on a file they had first uploaded through an ordinary multipart POST and then reached via /dev/fd/N, giving code execution as the app user without any user interaction. Defenders should upgrade to httpx 1.9.1, or else pass mode: :strict to response.json or keep multi_json installed.
items.score_reason: Ruby httpx 1.9.0 反序列化 RCE，CVE-2026-129784 CVSS 8.5
items.highlight: httpx 用 Oj.load 解码 JSON 时未指定 mode，Oj 默认 object 模式可实例化已加载 Ruby 类。攻击者控 URL 并以 multipart 上传落地文件，经 ActiveSupport 链致远程执行。
items.excerpt: httpx parses JSON response bodies through its transcoder layer. When the oj gem is loaded and multi_json is absent from the bundle, HTTPX::Response#json decodes the body with Oj.load(response.to_s) and no mode option.

items.title: Inside the Loop: Five AI Attack Frameworks that Never Ask Permission (15 minute read)
items.summary: Elastic analyzed five agentic offensive frameworks: ARTEX, CyberStrikeAI, Cairn, PentAGI, and HexStrike. These tools let an LLM drive scanners, shells, and cloud CLIs in bursts of two to 25 seconds. None of them enforce authorization in code, and ARTEX and CyberStrikeAI switch to new proxies and User-Agents when blocked. GTIG and Mandiant have already seen four of them in real intrusions, and Microsoft has linked ARTEX to Storm-0940. Defenders should choose ahead of time which detections can trigger automatic containment. Defenders should also pair IP blocks with token and session revocation, and track how quickly each identity acts and in what order across sessions rather than relying on framework fingerprints, which Elastic's own ES|QL hunt only partly addresses.
items.score_reason: Elastic 分析五个 agent 攻击框架，均未在代码层做授权
items.highlight: Elastic 通读 ARTEX、CyberStrikeAI、Cairn、PentAGI 与 HexStrike 源码：五者默认均不在代码中强制授权，只靠提示词宣称已获许可，默认限制仅域名黑名单。它们被拦后换代理与 UA，行为检测更耐久。
items.excerpt: Five agentic offensive frameworks act in bursts of two to 25 seconds, and none enforces authorization in code. What ARTEX, CyberStrikeAI, Cairn, PentAGI, and HexStrike leave in your telemetry, and the ES|QL hunt that catches them.

items.title: Cybersecurity at Machine Speed (21 minute read)
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is creating a revolutionary acceleration in cybersecurity, allowing attackers to operate at machine speed by compressing the OODA loop while defenders remain constrained by complex institutional governance. Because attackers need only one successful exploit among many while defenders must maintain safety, availability, and continuity across complex systems, organizations must adopt automated, policy-enforced boundaries and zero-trust architectures to bridge the asymmetry.
items.score_reason: 攻击方压缩 OODA 循环而防守方受治理拖累的机器速度论

items.excerpt: As a young West Point cadet, I studied military history and the technological innovations that have periodically transformed warfare. Strategists describe such transformations as Revolutions in Military Affairs: discontinuous changes in capabilities that demand fundamentally new ways of fighting.

items.title: Researchers track whole body movement with just a smartwatch (6 minute read)
items.summary: EchoMotion is a technology that can track the movement of a person's entire body using ultrasonic sound waves with just an off-the-shelf smartwatch and a lightweight AI model. The system uses the built-in speaker and microphone on a commercial smartwatch to determine a person's body position using a sonar-like sensing system. The technology could potentially be used for tracking workouts, daily activities, and progress on physical rehabilitation. The EchoMotion team is currently developing the technology for use in fitness tracking and exploring the use of the technology in combination with first-person vision on smart glasses to efficiently track the objects that a person handles.
items.score_reason: 用智能手表做全身动作追踪的声呐方案，方法有新意
items.highlight: 康奈尔团队用智能手表自带的扬声器和麦克风发射超声波并接收回波，配合轻量模型推断全身姿态，陌生用户单关节平均误差不足4英寸，校准后约2.4英寸，功耗仅约12毫瓦。
items.excerpt: For the first time, researchers can track the movement of a person's entire body with ultrasonic sound waves, using just an off-the-shelf smartwatch and a lightweight artificial intelligence model, all while ensuring privacy and efficiency.

items.title: Obituaries (27 minute read)
items.summary: Jensen Huang's recent resignation as CEO of Nvidia may spell the end for the company. This could pop the AI bubble, and the US chip ecosystem could pay the ultimate price. Huang's departure will also have impacts on tech company independence and American exceptionalism.

items.excerpt: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia on Thursday, November 12, 2026. He had been CEO of the company ever since he founded it on April 5, 1993. Nvidia started out as a graphics card company.

items.title: What does it mean to understand what we built? (4 minute read)
items.summary: AI gives us an incredible lookup tool, allowing us to free up mental capacity from having to understand everything in a system.

items.highlight: Marc Brooker 认为，把理解等同于读懂代码是六十年的惯性；真正该理解的是系统的已构建属性，从精确不变式到只能整体涌现的亚稳态故障。软件工程还没有自己的 Bode 图，AI 或许能让人从盯螺丝转向看整体。
items.excerpt: Today, a couple of people sent me the No AI Slop Manifesto. I found it interesting, in part, because it touches on something that seems super important right now: understanding. Through this work, we have come to value: … Understanding over speed.

items.title: Strategic Decision or Structural Advantage? (4 minute read)
items.summary: Anthropic captures most of the frontier state-of-the-art tokens and proprietary spend, while OpenAI captures most low-end tokens.

items.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter Join Forces (6 minute read)
items.summary: Hugging Face now routes language-model requests from its Inference Providers service through OpenRouter, which picks the best provider for each call. A single Hugging Face access token works for any open-weight model a provider serves.
items.score_reason: Hugging Face 推理流量接入 OpenRouter 统一路由
items.highlight: Hugging Face 把文本推理请求改由 OpenRouter 路由，按实时价格、速度和可靠性在 80 多家供应商间选路并自动重试；官方称容量错误降 46%、首字延迟改善 16.9%。
items.excerpt: Hugging Face and OpenRouter are teaming up to make open-weight models easy to run. Every major open-weight release is already being published on the Hugging Face Hub, and OpenRouter serves those models at scale, routing each request across 80+ providers based on live measurements of each one.

items.title: Staggering Scroll-Driven Animations with animation-range-start (7 minute read)
items.summary: Staggered scroll animations can use animation-range-start and sibling-index() instead of a custom progress formula. This post contains a worked example that replaces the complicated stagger calculation with one CSS declaration while retaining the browser's built-in easing behavior.
items.score_reason: 用 animation-range-start 与 sibling-index() 替代手算错峰，含完整示例
items.highlight: CSS-Tricks 作者用 animation-range-start 配合 sibling-index() 一行替代需自定义 CSS 函数和大量数学的滚动交错动画，让字符按滚动进度依次入场，省去复杂公式。
items.excerpt: The other day on the CSS-Tricks Slack channel, Danny Schwartz shared an interesting recent Master.dev article by Ashutosh Biswas on how to stagger CSS scrolling animations using several emergent CSS features and a lot of math, which Ashutosh admits is 'a huge formula and can look intimidating.'

items.title: Squircles (6 minute read)
items.summary: Squircles that look similar can have very different curvature, and Figma's approximation contains discontinuities where its curves join. This article contains an interactive comparison that explains the tradeoffs between Apple, Figma, clothoid, and superellipse shapes, along with the CSS for approximating Apple's corners using corner-shape.
items.score_reason: squircle 曲率差异与 Apple/Figma 近似方案对比，配套 CSS
items.highlight: Linebender 梳理 squircle 实现：超椭圆、平边方案、苹果与 Figma 差异及 CSS corner-shape 规范，强调 G2 连续性，并给出 superellipse(1.585) 逼近苹果图标的写法。
items.excerpt: A squircle is a shape intermediate between a square and a circle. There is no single mathematical definition, rather there are a number of curves that fit this shape. All general squircles are parametrized, and can vary between circle and square.

items.title: How Rust Changed Me as a Developer (10 minute read)
items.summary: Rust's enums make variants explicit and let the compiler enforce that every case is handled. This essay explores how sum types and static dispatch change abstraction choices, including when a straightforward enum is more useful than designing an interface.
items.score_reason: Rust 枚举与静态分发如何改变抽象选择，随笔
items.highlight: 作者用 Rust 六年、四年职业开发，认为语言差异越大越能改变人：enum 用和类型取代为抽象而抽象的接口，泛型与静态分发揭示分发方式与性能的联系，所有权摩擦逼出更松耦合的架构，宏则在编译期实现序列化与 CLI 框架。
items.excerpt: The programming language you use affects how you think as a software developer. You may have picked up JavaScript quickly knowing Python without it changing how you think, because those languages are similar. The more different a language is from what you're used to, the more it can change you.

items.title: BrowserPod 4.0 (9 minute read)
items.summary: BrowserPod runs a Linux-like WebAssembly microVM on the user's device, with tools including Node.js, git, bash, and Rust programs. Version 4.0 makes the CDN-loaded runtime free for commercial and production use without an account, while unrestricted networking is a separate service and self-hosting the runtime requires an enterprise license.
items.score_reason: BrowserPod 4.0 把 CDN 运行时改为可商用免费，涉及授权边界
items.highlight: 浏览器内 Wasm 微 VM 4.0 改为免费库，npm 装即用，无账号与遥测。fetch 网络在页面内做 TLS 终止，把 TCP 流量翻成 fetch()；Edge 网络新增任意端口 TCP，故内置 OpenSSH 与 pnpm 12。
items.excerpt: BrowserPod 4.0 is now free to use. Add a Linux-like microVM in WebAssembly to any website, with no account and no API key. Plus a new fetch network, TCP on BrowserPod Edge, SSH and pnpm 12.

items.title: Turso Sync: Local-First SQLite with Push and Pull (9 minute read)
items.summary: Turso Sync keeps writes local and replicates logical row changes through separate push and pull calls.
items.score_reason: Turso Sync 用 push/pull 复制逻辑行变更的本地优先 SQLite
items.highlight: Turso Sync 放弃 WAL 物理页复制，改在 Rust 重写的引擎里做行级 CDC，推送逻辑语句而非页面。API 拆成 push() 与 pull()，有长轮询；基准中小写入快 9-10 倍、数据省约 15 倍，冲突为最后推送者胜。
items.excerpt: Turso Sync ships logical changes instead of pages, so writes stay local and you decide when to push and pull. Here is how it works, what the benchmarks show, and where last-push-wins fits.

items.title: AI/ML DFIR Detection Pack (GitHub Repo)

items.excerpt: A vendor-neutral collection of Sigma, YARA, and Suricata rules for detecting compromise of LLM applications, MCP servers, ML supply chains, AI infrastructure, AI-powered insider threats, and RAG/vector database attacks.

items.title: Kitesurf is now open source (4 minute read)
items.summary: Cloudflare has open-sourced Kitesurf, its stateless browser for AI agents that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers. Available under the Apache 2.0 license on GitHub, the tool allows developers to run their own browser engine locally or deploy it to their Cloudflare accounts to support automated workloads using the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

items.title: Introducing spatial CSS: A developer preview (9 minute read)
items.summary: There has been a dramatic rise in the number of websites showing 3D content in the last few years. Spatial web standards should support designing for browsers wherever they run. Safari on visionOS 27.3 comes with a limited feature preview of the proposed spatial CSS API. This article demonstrates how to use the first components of spatial CSS through a case study.
items.score_reason: Safari 空间 CSS API 开发者预览，含实际用法与限制
items.highlight: visionOS 27.3 的 Safari 以特性开关预览 spatial CSS：portal 共享三维空间、transform 与 position-anchor 摆放模型、@environment-map 复用光照，可移出窗口。
items.excerpt: Safari on visionOS 27.3 comes with an important update: a limited feature preview of the proposed spatial CSS API, with an initial focus on working with 3D objects through the <model> element. While it's a big conceptual jump, spatial CSS itself is made of a lot of small tweaks to existing syntax.

items.title: US moves to cut China's remote access to AI chips (9 minute read)
items.summary: The US Commerce Department is closing a loophole that previously allowed foreign rivals to bypass export restrictions on advanced computer chips by renting access to them from data centers in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Brazil. Companies headquartered in countries deemed to present a higher-than-normal risk of diversion to China, Russia, and Iran must now apply for a license with strict know-your-customer controls when transferring high volumes of advanced chips. Companies with a license must submit monthly reports on transactions that thoroughly detail all parties involved. The rule change will take effect 90 days after it's posted to the Federal Register.
items.score_reason: 美商务部封堵境外租用算力绕开出口管制，涉及五国数据中心
items.highlight: 新规把印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、巴西等地数据中心对外出租高端芯片算力纳入许可管理，要求了解客户并月度报备最终去向，90 天后生效；报道也指出执行力度与部门内部分歧仍是变数。
items.excerpt: On the heels of the Nvidia scandal, the Trump administration is preparing to crack down on foreign data centers that are fueling China's advancements in artificial intelligence by allowing remote access to otherwise restricted high-end chips necessary for AI training.

items.title: World 2030 (8 minute read)
items.summary: Predicting how AI will affect the economy requires looking at all of the different components of that economy and figuring out how they might affect each other. World 2030 is a study that sets up nine groups (AI labs, big employers, banks and insurers, utilities, startups, universities, workers, governments, and the Fed) and runs the US economy forward in six-month turns to 2030. It aimed to identify both the invariants and the boundaries of what can change as these powerful forces interact with each other. The study predicts that AI will break per-seat software pricing and cut US junior desk hiring.

items.excerpt: Most of what is interesting about the future comes from the interaction of different entities over time. That is what makes prediction so difficult, because the nuances of how they interact dramatically change what can actually happen.

items.title: New NoisyTCP Vulnerabilities Lets Attackers Crash Linux Servers (2 minute read)
items.summary: Security researcher Hyunwoo Kim discovered an 11-year old Linux kernel vulnerability that can be used to crash systems running Nginx, Apache, and SSH servers in default configurations. The vulnerability stems from a NULL pointer dereference bug in the kernel's TCP networking system. Unauthenticated attackers can trigger a race condition using maliciously crafted packets to cause a DoS on a system.

items.excerpt: An 11-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability, dubbed NoisyTCP, affects almost all Linux distributions and lets attackers crash systems running Nginx, Apache, and SSH servers with default configurations.

items.title: Agents Need an Undo Button, Not More Approval Prompts (8 minute read)
items.summary: AI agents need reliable undo mechanisms rather than frequent, fatigue-inducing approval prompts for high-impact actions. Borrowing from database and distributed systems design like the Sagas pattern, tools can be categorized into four types based on reversibility: reversible, compensable, delayable, and irreversible. Tracking and executing undos should live in the underlying system rather than within the agent itself to maintain robust safety oversight.
items.score_reason: agent 需要可撤销机制而非更多审批，用 Sagas 分类四类可逆性
items.highlight: 文章主张把审批提示换成可撤销性设计：按可逆、可补偿、可延迟、不可逆四类为每个工具建档，把撤销记录留在Agent之外，并承认撤销会随时间失效，注意力应只留给不可逆动作。
items.excerpt: The default way to make an AI agent safe is to make it ask. Before it sends the email, issues the refund or runs the migration, a person clicks Approve. It is easy to build and easy to explain, and security guidance recommends it for high-impact actions.

items.title: When will humans actually fly on Starship? (3 minute read)
